verdicts.reason: Both use the same left-to-right banner layout: headline, a tiny phone, the CTA, then fine print. In both, the phone is too small to read and is reduced to a smudge, and the '7 days free, then 6/month' fine print wraps awkwardly onto three lines and is pushed against the right edge. B places the phone almost against the CTA button, which makes the middle feel crowded, and changes the button text's capitalisation ('Try it Free'). A spaces the headline, phone and button slightly more evenly.
